title: Patricia SR NDE 9995
content: I was 11 years old and it was an extremely hot, Sunday. My aunt and uncle had come to visit. We were going to go to the Jersey shore as soon as my Dad came home. I took the dog on a long walk so he wouldn't have to go in the house while we were gone. I was sweating by the time we returned. My dad had a super-8 camera and projector that he had taught me how to use. My mom asked me if I could get one of our family films to play. I leaned over the projector and began to feed the film in, but it became jammed. I leaned over to try to get the film straightened out. But somehow, I looked directly into the light. I felt a jolt, then I attempted to stand but my vision was affected. I saw colors in front of my eyes. I called out to Mom. She came running from the kitchen with my uncle. The light was getting brighter and brighter. I felt my consciousness growing distant from them. I could hear them, but I couldn't respond. Soon, I was above them. I wanted to go back to my family but I couldn't reach them. I was so scared. Then everything went black. I woke up in a hospital emergency room. Apparently, I had died or nearly died and had to be resuscitated three times. I spent ten days in the hospital, undergoing many tests. They were uncertain of the exact cause. What I can say is that this experience altered my life. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: July 1972 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain. Illness Other: I am not quite sure of the cause, but my mom said that I had to be resuscitated three times, but I cannot remember this part. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw my mother in distress and calling my name. I couldn't respond to her. I felt sad and scared. I wanted to go to her. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt out of control but extremely heightened emotionally. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? floating over my family Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I lost track of how long it was. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. slightly blurry and distant. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. everyone seemed to be muffled. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain. The light was bright but I am not sure if it was unearthly. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was not in the earthly world and there was a barrier that I couldn't break through. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Fear and anxiety. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I fought to come back. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I have been a seeker my entire life. What is your religion now? Other faiths- New age I adhere to Catholic customs but I also have adopted some other beliefs Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I became more religious after this and began to read many spiritual books. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I became aware of others and committed to being a helper in life. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain. I have had many unexplainable experiences that deny rationale. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I often can sense things before they occur. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain I didn't realize it at the time but after this experience, I have psychic or death-related awareness. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I had a heightened awareness and could sense people. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I am gentle with others. Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I blacked out. When I woke up, I was very confused about where I was and what had transpired. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. This experience haunted me for a long time. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I have many stories of receiving warnings, guides and early notifications of loved ones who would be passing. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? the feeling that I was chosen to walk in between two worlds. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Right away, we all tried to process what had occurred and wondered if it would happen again. But, I never had a convulsion again. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I gained some sort of psychic ability after this. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? too many redundant questions. lzepru0_nde

environment.environment_other_detail: She reported being "not in the earthly world" and encountering "a barrier that I couldn't break through," with light becoming "brighter and brighter," then "everything went black."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Uncertain cause; occurred after looking directly into a super-8 projector light; later reported needing resuscitation three times.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience included escalating light, fear, blackness, and waking in a hospital ER; no tunnel, no beings, no life review.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Light exposure and visual disturbance preceded the OBE; she then perceived being above family, encountered blackness, and later awoke in the hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Trigger involved looking directly into a super-8 projector light; perceptual sequence of brightening light → consciousness distancing → OBE above family → blackness → awakening in ER; later described feeling "chosen to walk in between two worlds."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Soon, I was above them. I wanted to go back to my family but I couldn't reach them. I was so scared. Then everything went black.”
